title: MDPlus content-safe file IPC v1
description: Additive commands. All property names are camelCase. Revisions are opaque byte-content identifiers, never mtimes. A null expectedRevision requires a missing target, not an unconditional overwrite. All errors reject the IPC Promise with FileError; consumers retain dirty content on every error. Legacy read_file/write_file remain available, but document saves must use write_document.

RevisionState.description: Both values are null only for NotFound. Permission, sharing, size, and invalid-path errors reject rather than pretending the file is missing. Does not decode the text, so it can inspect an explicitly selected replacement target.

expectedRevision.description: null means create only if absent. An existing target requires the exact revision last read or explicitly confirmed. There is no force flag.

WriteReceipt.description: Only returned after verified commit. revision/mtime describe the committed local bytes, not a later unrelated file read. Verified commits clean temporary copies where possible; backupPath is non-null if a previous-version backup could not be removed. Uncertain/conflicted replacements reject with retained paths.

ImageRequest.description: docPath may be a not-yet-created document in an existing directory. Backend validates basename and supported image bytes, creates only under sibling assets, and allocates the name exclusively. Only AlreadyExists retries.

recoveryPath.description: Durable local draft when available; never a consumed staging filename.

backupPath.description: Retained previous on-disk bytes when available. Do not overwrite the target automatically to roll back a conflict.

writeState.description: unchanged: this operation did not replace the target. committed: replacement occurred but must not be accepted as a clean save. unknown: OS replacement may have partially changed paths. Always keep dirty content and show retained paths.
